description: This file defines the TypeManagementOptions class, which contains configuration settings related to type management in the Orleans framework, focusing on in-place upgrade scenarios. It includes a setting for specifying how frequently the cluster grain interface map should be refreshed.

classes.name: TypeManagementOptions
classes.description: Represents configuration options for type management within Orleans, including refresh interval for cluster grain interface mapping.
